description: This file defines the PersistableCustomerPopulator class which converts Customer model objects into PersistableCustomer entities, specifically populating customer address details (billing and delivery), personal info, and store-related data.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerPopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to facilitate conversion from Customer object to PersistableCustomer, including address and personal details.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts and populates customer data from the source Customer object to the target PersistableCustomer object, including billing and delivery addresses, personal info, and store code.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Stub method for creating a new PersistableCustomer instance, currently returns null.
